india.one_line: IIT Delhi launched Adi Vaani for tribal languages, HP released an AI laptop, and Nasscom warned of IT market shifts.

themes.title: Adi Vaani expands tribal language translation
themes.text: IIT Delhi and the Ministry of Tribal Affairs developed Adi Vaani, an AI platform supporting ten tribal languages with speech-to-speech translation.

stories.headline: Adi Vaani platform expands AI translation for tribal languages

themes.title: Nasscom report assesses AI market impacts
themes.text: A Nasscom report indicates that artificial intelligence could shrink traditional markets for software maintenance and call centres while lowering software development costs.

stories.headline: Nasscom report says AI may shrink traditional IT and call centre markets

themes.title: HP launches AI laptop in India
themes.text: HP launched the OmniBook Ultra 16 AI laptop in India at ₹5,49,999, targeting developers and creative professionals running local workloads.

stories.headline: HP launches OmniBook Ultra 16 AI laptop in India at ₹5,49,999
